name: Hotel Costanero Montevideo - Mgallery
positioning: Eco-certified MGallery Collection hotel by Pocitos Bay in Montevideo, with sea-view rooms and a wellness area with a pool, gym and sauna
best_for: Travelers who want sea views from their room on Montevideo's Pocitos Bay
Guests who want a wellness area with a pool, sauna and spa treatments in the city

facts.text: The hotel is part of the MGallery Collection.
Los Pocitos beach is among the natural places listed near the hotel.
The Executive Room has a king-size bed and a sea view.
The spa offers bespoke treatments and wellness rituals.
The fitness center offers personalized training.
Cauce Restaurant is on the hotel's first floor with a view of the sea and serves mainly Uruguayan and international cuisine.
Cauce Bar serves tapas, drinks, cafeteria service, snacks, sandwiches, desserts and pastries.
The hotel is pet-friendly and allows small pets.
The Tristan Narvaja street market takes place every Sunday.
Parque Rodo is a place to enjoy the sunset.
The hotel has a space for corporate and social events.

highlights.text: The hotel is in Montevideo, by Pocitos Bay.
The Deluxe suite has a king-size bed, a balcony and a sea view.
The hotel has a wellness area with a swimming pool, a gym and a sauna.

considerations.text: The Solis Theater is 7.1 km from the hotel, about a 15-minute drive.
Up to one child can stay in the same room as the parents.
WhataHotel notes that the boutique size means fewer on-site facilities.
